ConnectionDetails.description:
Part of Private Endpoint description that stores information about a connection between Private Endpoint and Notification Hubs namespace.
This is internal class, not visible to customers, and we use it only to discover the link identifier.

groupId.description: Group name. Always "namespace" for Notification Hubs.

id.description:
A unique ID of the connection. This is not the ARM id, but rather an internal identifier set by the Networking RP. Notification Hubs code
does not analyze it.

linkIdentifier.description:
Link identifier. This is a string representation of an integer that is also encoded in every IPv6 frame received by Front Door,
and we use it to create implicit authorization rule that allows connection from the associated Private Endpoint.

memberName.description: Member name. Always "namespace" for Notification Hubs.

privateIpAddress.description: IP address of the Private Endpoint. This is not used by Notification Hubs.

get.description:
Even though this namespace requires subscription id, resource group and namespace name, it returns a constant payload (for a given namespacE) every time it's called.
That's why we don't send it to the sibling RP, but process it directly in the scale unit that received the request.
